description: AKA Ignition is a focused, three-person development team composed of first-year Computer Science and Engineering students driven to solve complex aerospace challenges through intuitive AI applications. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, the team is exclusively tackling the "Flame in Freefall" problem statement by engineering a modern, full-stack web dashboard that translates decades of dense microgravity combustion data into accessible, actionable fire safety insights.
